title: Intelligent Dispatcher – AI-Driven Prescriptive Maintenance (2nd Place @ Cummins AI Hackathon)
tagline: Won 2nd Place at Cummins AI Hackathon by reducing “Second Visit” costs by 40% and restoring engine uptime 50% faster through an Agentic AI maintenance ecosystem.
description: Architected an end-to-end Predictive Maintenance system for Cummins engines, integrating IoT telemetry with SAP Business Network Asset Collaboration (BNAC). Developed an Agentic AI “Dispatcher” using GPT-4o and RAG to automate root-cause analysis and prescribe specific toolkits. The solution uses IoT telemetry to predict failures and Generative AI to prescribe a complete “Mission Briefing” for technicians, effectively collapsing the diagnostic and repair phases into a single, proactive dispatch. Engineered a Multi-class Classification model (Scikit-Learn) to map high-frequency engine sensor data to J1939 fault codes with 85%+ accuracy.

title: Intellekt AI for SAP
tagline: Reduced billing disputes by 40% and addressed $2B+ in annual billing errors by integrating AI-driven automation workflows into SAP BTP Cloud Platform.
description: As an SAP consultant to Intellekt AI, I advised on product selection and workflow design. I led the integration of SAP BTP Cloud Platform for AI-driven payroll and vendor management, specifically designing automation workflows using wrapper APIs to address critical billing inaccuracies. This solution significantly improved cash flows and operational efficiency for large-scale enterprise clients.

title: Supply Chain Risk Monitoring
tagline: Improved supplier reliability and reduced disruption risks by implementing a predictive modeling roadmap and data lake house architecture.
description: Led the product roadmap for a comprehensive Supply Chain Risk Monitoring system. By leveraging predictive modeling and a data lake house architecture, the project enabled real-time tracking of supplier risks. I defined the product roadmap using the MoSCoW framework, ensuring that the solution directly addressed customer pain points and aligned with strategic business goals.
